sentence: A shared timeline card of past memories and upcoming dates for a group, where anyone can add an entry and tap "I was there" or "I'm in", and only the adder can remove it.
use_when: The group wants a recap of the semester with memories and what is coming up
Friends want to log shared events and see who was there or who is joining
Someone asks for a recap card or a shared timeline of dates
dont_use_when: The group needs to pick one date or option by voting, which needs a poll
Someone needs a private reminder or personal to-do list
The group wants to split costs or track who owes what
